title: Conditional dark matter particle identification
description: H_DM asks whether the derived energy-equivalent mass belongs to a massive dark matter degree of freedom. Elastic Xe recoil compatibility alone does not establish that identity.

quantities.name: conditional_candidate_mass
quantities.reference: Derived in run-001/prediction.json, not hard-coded by the implementation

assumptions: H_OCTAVE_84 has an independently justified physical realization
Mass equivalent is separately identified as particle rest mass
Spin-independent elastic contact scattering is only a declared benchmark
confusion_guard: 248 keV is a supplied unverified recoil observation claim, not a rest mass, model constant or detection.
falsification_conditions: Independent particle evidence contradicts the mass or required properties.
A calibrated preregistered spectrum rejects a completed model with independently fixed nonzero coupling.

evidence.notes: Conditional mass derivation only; particle identification remains unestablished.
